# A loop of components renders on win32: each copy a keyed `for` keeps is a
# component built at run time, which placement writes as a record -- a box
# struct of its vars and nodes, its constructor the body, its setters and
# teardown functions of the package taking it -- and a test reaches one copy
# through the package's map from each copy's key to its node, which the
# render that stamps the keys starts afresh, so a copy the render no longer
# makes is null.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/dropped.png

# A loop at the top of a component's body renders into the container the
# platform's #[gen.protocol(contents)] makes, which the component's other
# top nodes go into in the order written.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c top.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# Three controls a copy, an input's value an effect writes: the effect's
# mount reads the input its render slot made, which placement holds in a
# package var beside the slot's local, and each copy's handler still reads
# its own.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c rows.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A method of a nested component the test calls through its instance is
# handed no receiver: its state is the program's.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c nested.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component main ui.node {
    var names = ["ann", "bob", "cy"]
    var picked = ""
    ui.vbox {
        for var name = names {
            ui.button #row(text=name, @click { picked = name })
        }
        ui.button #drop(text="Drop", @click { names = ["dee"] })
    }
}

ui.window {
    main()
}

func testAClickReachesItsCopy(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.row[1].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "bob")
    c.row[2].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "cy")
}

func testARenderReplacesTheCopies(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.row[2] != null)
    c.drop.click()
    t.assert(c.row[1] == null)
    t.assert(c.row[2] == null)
    c.row[0].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "dee")
    t.snapshot("dropped")
}

-- top.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var seen = ""
    var xs = ["a", "b"]
    for var x = xs {
        button #pick(text=x, @click { seen = seen + x })
    }
}

func testClickInLoop(t Test, c main) {
    c.pick[1].click()
    c.pick[0].click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "ba")
}

-- rows.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        button #swap(text="swap", @click { items = ["c", "d", "e"] })
        for var it = items {
            button #tap(text=it, @click { log = it })
            checkbox #box(label=it, @change(on) { log = "{it} {on}" })
            input #field(value=it, @change(v) { log = "{it}={v}" })
        }
        text(value=log)
    }
}

func testOneCopy(t Test, c main) {
    c.tap[1].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "b")
    c.box[0].change(true)
    t.assert(c.log == "a true")
    c.field[1].change("x")
    t.assert(c.log == "b=x")
}

func testOneCopyAfterTheLoopRendersAgain(t Test, c main) {
    c.swap.click()
    c.tap[2].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "e")
    c.box[1].change(true)
    t.assert(c.log == "d true")
    c.field[0].change(value="y")
    t.assert(c.log == "c=y")
}

window {
    main
}

-- nested.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component bar(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    func reset() {
        hits = 0
    }
    vbox {
        button #btn(text=label, @click {
            hits = hits + 1
        })
        text #shown(value="{label}: {hits}")
        for var i = [1] {
            button #row(text="r{i}", @click {
                hits = hits + 10
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var greeting = "hello"
    vbox {
        bar #b(label="go")
        text #t(value=greeting)
    }
}

func testANestedComponentsStateAndNodes(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.btn.click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.b.shown.value == "go: 1")
    c.b.reset()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 0)
}

func testANodesOneWayProp(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.t.value == "hello")
    c.greeting = "bye"
    t.assert(c.t.value == "bye")
    t.assert(c.b.label == "go")
}

func testOneCopyOfALoopInANestedComponent(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.row[0].click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 10)
}

window {
    main
}
